gen-indie-flower-space-grotesk: Loose, friendly Indie Flower handwriting up top. Space Grotesk, a plain sans drawn as a ribbon of constant width, steadies it, though it's better for a quick look than pages of text.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hepta-slab: Loud, cheerful letters with a high mean line. Luckiest Guy is best at grabbing attention, while Hepta Slab, a classic serif with open counters and a stretched-out look, is best at holding it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-glegoo: Nixie One keeps a constant stroke from top to baseline, with open curves and clear gaps. And Glegoo, a classic serif with big counters and a tall lowercase, brings a refined, editorial tone.
gen-nixie-one-gf-piazzolla: Retro-tech and nostalgic: Nixie One keeps its curves open with clear gaps. Piazzolla, a classic serif whose lowercase nearly matches the capitals, carries a refined, authoritative voice quietly underneath.
gen-nixie-one-gf-scope-one: Scope One, a classic serif with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, lets its counters spill into the space around it. Under Nixie One's cable-like lines, reading flows on smoothly.
gen-righteous-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Righteous packs the line with commanding, fun bowls. Padyakke Expanded One, a serif with wide pitcher-like mouths, spreads out beneath it, so the two trade a shout for literary authority.
gen-silkscreen-gf-hanuman: Lo-fi and retro, Silkscreen leaves space around every letter you can almost feel. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, steps in with traditional, refined composure.
gen-silkscreen-gf-kadwa: Retro by nature, Silkscreen spaces its spaghetti-like lines out wide, while Kadwa, a classic serif, brings a larger-than-usual x-height. Its open-ended curves keep the text feeling classic and editorial.
gen-silkscreen-gf-noticia-text: Dignified and literary, the text face sits under Silkscreen's spaced-out, lo-fi lettering. Noticia Text, a classic serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height, gives the wirelike heading a sturdy counterweight.
gen-silkscreen-gf-scope-one: Scope One is a text serif with stubby ascenders. Give Scope One generous size, since its counters spill into surrounding space, while Silkscreen supplies the lo-fi, spaced-out spaghetti lines.
